about: Cases for the universe spec coverage rule in docs/universe-spec-coverage.md. Paths in knowledge_bus and presets are relative to the repository root; copy them with this file, keeping relative paths. top, file and at are relative to one imaginary root; at is the folder holding that .knowledge-bus/. coverage is null when that .knowledge-bus/ has no coverage.yaml; otherwise it names the file, which may be empty. Code is correct when it gives every expected answer, compared by value, and for each expected error the same category and candidates. Each message is kbp's wording, for reference only.
